description: This file defines a class `FormatWithBase64Encode` that implements a value formatting strategy by encoding input values into Base64. It is part of a plugin system within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for formatting values in access strategies.

classes.name: FormatWithBase64Encode
classes.description: A class that implements value formatting by encoding the input value into Base64 encoding.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the Base64-encoded string of the provided entity value.
